text: The spectral theorem for compact self-adjoint operators on a Hilbert space guarantees:
choices: a continuous spectrum filling an interval
complex eigenvalues arranged in conjugate pairs
an orthonormal basis of eigenvectors with real eigenvalues that accumulate only at 0
that the operator has no eigenvalues at all
explanation: A compact self-adjoint operator has an orthonormal eigenbasis with real eigenvalues that can accumulate only at 0, the infinite-dimensional analogue of diagonalizing a symmetric matrix. Applied to Sturm-Liouville problems it yields the complete orthogonal eigenfunction expansions used in Fourier methods.
